deskyard size: print the screen size

Usage: deskyard [-c COMPUTER] size

Prints the screen size in pixels.

Prints: one line "W H", e.g. "1280 800"

Examples:
  deskyard size

Where: inside a computer it acts locally; elsewhere on the chosen computer (-c COMPUTER)
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; otherwise the exit code of the action on the desktop
